verdict.rationale: Datadog's first-party integrations catalog advertises 1,000+ vendor-maintained integrations. The directory lists cloud services such as Alibaba Cloud and Amazon API Gateway alongside Agent Metrics, and Kubernetes Autoscaling and OpenTelemetry docs show Kubernetes and OTel-based collection paths. A customer notes having to fall back to OTel for Elixir because no Datadog SDK exists, which is a minor coverage gap. Missing for 10: explicit evidence describing the host/container Agent and its Kubernetes deployment (only page titles are present), and independent hands-on corroboration of infrastructure instrumentation breadth.
